what: The blind audit behind 'with MedGemma's change cut into six hidden pieces, it predicted from the weights alone whether each would help or hurt scan reading, and got all six right'. Fable (as auditor, a separate session from run skillmove_run1) received the six pieces under random letters, read only their weights, and locked its predictions (change in SLAKE F1 points when the piece alone is added to Gemma 3) before any of them was scored. Measured: Gemma 3 plus the piece, SLAKE seed 0, minus Gemma 3 seed 0 (rows in scores.csv).
